html:
Emergency Dentistry

Emergency Dentist in Kansas City, MO

Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry Westport's emergency dentist in Kansas City, MO provides root canals, extractions, and other critical types of urgent dental care. We provide same-day care for patients with all types of dental issues. An urgent dental matter can cause severe pain and suffering and cause worry and unease. That's why our team responds swiftly to our patients' emergency requests and resolves them quickly. We will assess and diagnose your precise issue and determine the best solution for fixing it fast and carefully. We are available to restore your oral health and prevent future harm from occurring.
Contact Us

Get Immediate Help for Your Teeth

Getting treatment soon after an emergency oral health issue is crucial. The sooner you visit the dentist, the sooner they can alleviate your suffering and restore your mouth, teeth, or gums. We recommend going to the dentist immediately if you're experiencing one or more of the following:

  • Chronic or severe toothaches or oral pain that refuses to stop.
  • Sudden trauma or impact that breaks or damages your tooth, such as a sports injury.
  • Sore, inflamed, receding, or bleeding gums.
  • Painful chips or cracks.
  • Loose or missing teeth.
  • Loose or lost crowns, bridges, and implants.
  • Pain or discomfort caused by advancing tooth decay or disease.

Overcome Your Unforeseen Dental Issue

Unfortunately, dental trauma and other issues can occur without warning, and they're often the most painful and inconvenient. From tripping and falling to getting hit by a heavy object, your mouth is among the most vulnerable parts of your body. When the worst or unexpected happens, you can depend on Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry Westport to restore your oral health. Our office is equipped with cutting-edge technology and skilled dentists with years of experience in urgent dental situations. We prioritize our patients' safety and security and adhere to the strictest protocols. We will comfort you in your time of need and devote ourselves to your care.

Choose Us for the Perfect Smile

Call Now
